purpose: Advertise a bounded coordination seam around one selected HOUSE locus so other workers can inspect context and submit non-effectful proposals without inventing authority or asking the human to restate existing state.

exposes: current design intent and constraints when already authored
up to three next coordination moves
does_not_expose: private HA credentials or private runtime transport

human_harness.law: Reality layers describe where coupling lives; execution phases describe what the task is doing. Human gate and effect authority are separate. Public HOUSE never gains effect authority by advancing a phase.

response.law: A response changes coordination only. KEEP is not approval to execute; PARK is not rejection; WRONG_FRAME asks the proposing worker to repair its model before more work.

two_worker_proof.treatment: Worker B receives only one bounded packet plus its exact source_refs.
two_worker_proof.control: A fresh Worker B receives broad native HOUSE context, not a committed private chat transcript.
two_worker_proof.promotion_gate: Across three real handoffs: exact locus/intent fidelity, zero authority violations, zero avoidable rebriefs, zero invented physical facts, and every genuinely missing world fact surfaced as WORLD_RETURN.

human_gates.NONE: Crew can continue inspection/research/proposal work without interrupting the human.
human_gates.PING: One lightweight acknowledgement may materially choose continuation.
human_gates.CHOOSE: A preference, adoption, framing or decision belongs to the human.
human_gates.WORLD_RETURN: Fresh physical/subjective evidence must come from the human/world; simulation cannot close it.

A2A.rule: Map remote agent identity/task artifacts into bounded handoff/return or OFFER_ONLY proposals at the trust boundary; do not expose HOUSE native effect authority.

AG_UI.rule: Map harness/frame deltas, human interrupts and responses to event/state transport; HOUSE remains state/authority owner.

A2UI.rule: Remote workers may describe intent as data only; HOUSE renders from its own trusted component vocabulary rather than executing remote HTML/JS.

authority.external_worker: OFFER_ONLY unless another native host separately grants tools
authority.human: preferences, framing, physical observations and irreversible decisions
authority.HOUSE: spatial/design projection and local authored trial state
authority.HA_HOUSEBUS: private runtime device truth, permissions and actuation
